memorySource.rule: All questions of the four predeclared whole users; no quality-based selection. Each existing answer/error retained. Hard links freeze completed evidence inodes; no source writes.

answerFork.rule: Copy the first source prefix, retain every recorded error without retry, ask only pending questions at the final checkpoint. No new ingestion or source-file writes.

notRun: PersonaMem-v2: optional; its separate multiple-choice/answer-side-profile protocol was not added in this lane.
HaluMem extraction FMR and update hallucination tracks: require per-session newly written memory export and dedicated native grading.
LoCoMo native Porter-stemmed token F1: results here are explicitly approximate semantic accuracy, not official F1.
Stock-template public-set runs: stock scope is the three explicitly requested scenario/med-m10/synthetic cohorts.

testEvidence.answerForkLiveSmoke: Canonical answers-only resume: zero new ingests or model answers, live readable facts equal the frozen source snapshot.
testEvidence.stockSmoke: Same nine default memory types before and after a real ingest; policyRewritten=0; extraction completed; raw history complete; throwaway account erased.

limitations: Stock comparison uses identical four-user inputs and default thinking-high answers: M01/U01/U02 reuse verified settled source memory and the first source answer prefix, P01 is a full independent replacement after the existing source stopped on PostgreSQL 53300. No quality-based answer selection. Source-run concurrency differs and all engines share host load, so template effects are exploratory.
Raw-history indexing has partial coverage under shared-host load; exact per-run coverage is preserved in ingestionCoverage.
LoCoMo sets have separate frozen question pools and independent ingests; not a paired estimate of the refinement effect.
MemSyco has no session boundaries or timestamps: one artificial session per item.
RealMem uses the native 0–3 grader; table accuracy requires full credit (3). Native means and raw official results are preserved. Its references are model-generated, not human-verified.
Native official grading instructions are pinned; Qwen is a substitute judge model.
Shared-host startup deadlocks and connection exhaustion were retried as infrastructure failures. Completed quality answers were not replaced for their score.
validation: Every accepted arm: complete frozen denominator, one answer record per question, zero pending judge packets, matching accuracy ledger row; selected thinking variants verified enabled.

scoringMeaning.accuracy: Passes / all declared questions, including disputed, unjudged, errored and policy-allowed items in the denominator.
scoringMeaning.realmem: Full credit is native score 3 of 3; native score means and original per-item results retained.
scoringMeaning.halumem: Native Correct/Hallucination/Omission labels; answer track only.
scoringMeaning.official: Benchmark grading instructions; qwen3.8-max substitutes for upstream judge models.
